title: [Feature] Add decode offloading to Mooncake Store consumers
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
refer to : https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52466 , add decode offloading to Mooncake Store consumers for MRV1 and MRV2.The modified code has been decoupled from MRV1/MRV2 and tested on both MRV1 and MRV2.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

### How was this patch tested?

test reuslt(ms):
|metrics|base|this pr|improve|
 | :---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
 |kv hit rate|60%|93.5%|+55.8%|
 |TTFT|684ms|431ms|-36.8%|

mooncake.json
```
{
    "metadata_server": "P2PHANDSHAKE",
    "protocol": "ascend",
    "device_name": "",
    "master_server_address": "127.0.0.1:50088",
    "global_segment_size": "128GB"
}
```
mooncake.sh
```
mooncake_master --port 50088 --eviction_high_watermark_ratio 0.9 --eviction_ratio 0.1
```
model script:
```
export TP=8
export MODEL_PATH=/nas/disk2/GLM-4.7-W8A8
export MODEL_NAME=Qwen3-14B
export PORT=10113
#export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=6,7,10,11,12,13,14,15
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/:/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/python/site-packages/mooncake/:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH="/nas/disk2/xk/202609/mooncake/mooncake.json"
export ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1
export ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL=4:8
export ASCEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=10000
export ASCEND_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT=10000
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server  --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT} --max-model-len  32768 --compilation-config '{"max_cudagraph_capture_size": 128}' --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'  --model ${MODEL_PATH} --served-model-name ${MODEL_NAME} --tensor-parallel-size ${TP} --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9  --no-enable-prefix-caching --max-model-len  32768 --trust-remote-code --kv-transfer-config '{
    "kv_connector": "AscendStoreConnector",
    "kv_role": "kv_both",
    "kv_connector_extra_config": {
      "backend": "mooncake",
      "lookup_rpc_port": "0",
      "save_decode_cache": true
    }
  }'
```
base script just need change  "save_decode_cache" param to false.  Add "export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1" param into script to test on MRV2.

test script:
```
export MODEL_NAME=/nas/disk2/GLM-4.7-W8A8

python /model/xk/vllm/benchmarks/multi_turn/benchmark_serving_multi_turn.py --url http://127.0.0.1:10113 --model $MODEL_NAME --served-model-name Qwen3-14B --seed 1234 --input-file ./generate_multi_turn.json \
--num-clients 8 --max-active-conversations 24
```
generate_multi_turn.json:
```
{
    "filetype": "generate_conversations",
    "num_conversations": 48,
    "text_files": ["pg1184.txt"],
    "print_stats": false,
    "prompt_input": {
        "num_turns": {
            "distribution": "uniform",
            "min": 12,
            "max": 18
        },
        "common_prefix_num_tokens": {
            "distribution": "constant",
            "value": 500
        },
        "prefix_num_tokens": {
            "distribution": "lognormal",
            "average": 300,
            "max": 600
        },
        "num_tokens": {
            "distribution": "uniform",
            "min": 120,
            "max": 160
        }
    },
    "prompt_output": {
        "num_tokens": {
            "distribution": "uniform",
            "min": 1000,
            "max": 2000
        }
    }
}
```

If you want to test the decode offloading of the kv_comsumer role, you need to add parameters "consumer_is_to_load": true like in the upstream vllm to enable lookup. 
```
        {
            "kv_connector": "AscendStoreConnector",
            "kv_role": "kv_consumer",
            "kv_connector_extra_config": {
                "lookup_rpc_port": "0",
                "backend": "mooncake",
                "save_decode_cache": true,
                "consumer_is_to_load": true
            }
        }
```

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607
